title: Order status state machine
prompt: Inside `Solution`, write `enum OrderStatus { PENDING, PAID, SHIPPED, CANCELLED }` and `static boolean canCancel(OrderStatus s)` returning true only for PENDING and PAID. Also `static OrderStatus next(OrderStatus s)`: PENDING→PAID, PAID→SHIPPED, and for SHIPPED/CANCELLED the state stays itself (terminal).

tests.name: cancellation rules
tests.hint: Only the two early stages allow cancellation.
